exact_symbolic_global_cut.witness_above_breakpoint: one complete Petersen fiber: 120 cold boundary edges and zero hot boundary edges

theorem: For cold capacity 1 and hot capacity rho>0, the exact worst-pair min-cut is min(12+3 rho,120), with breakpoint rho=36. The proof uses edge-connectivity 12 of the cold graph, edge-connectivity 3 of every Petersen fiber, edge-connectivity 10 of the 27-vertex quotient, and exactly 12 cold physical edges per quotient edge. Failure of all shortcut edges in even one Petersen fiber collapses the global min-cut to exactly 12 for every positive rho.
execution: independent NetworkX edge-connectivity, Stoer-Wagner and Gomory-Hu computations on the reconstructed two-orbit 270-router, plus the structural quotient proof
boundary: Exact undirected edge-capacity/min-cut theorem for the finite router. It is not a queueing, latency, directed-switch or measured-hardware claim.
